detail.description:
【Collect 100+ Unique Tataris!】
Forget generic designs! Collect them all in just 1 month—from the goofy Frugling to the sassy Solpear!

【Evolve to Power Up!】
Reach formidable Tier 4 evolutions and unlock rare Glitter forms! How many can you get?

【Strategy-Based Battles】
Mix and match formations to discover powerful combos! Crush the Zobo waves with your strategic genius!

【Build Your Tatari Paradise】
Craft a cozy home and interact with your pets— what happens if you drop Frostnip in the pool?
detail.releaseNotes:
1 Added Tier 4 evolutions: Lightning Fluffle → Cosmoram, Grass Buddi → Heliabloom.
2 New Rock Tatari: Momopo and its evolutions have exclusive Horde Invasion skills.
3 Limited-Time Event: Chip Charge! Defeat specified Zobo Boss waves to obtain enhancement chips.
4 New Pinball Machine Event: Radish Run. Complete it to earn Energy Drinks.
5 Bento Maker Upgrade: Added Elemental Bento crafting with daily limited-time recipes.
6 New Release Podium: Duplicate max-star Tatari can be released for gifts; max star cap increased by 6.
